body:
https://github.com/duckdblabs/duckdb-internal/issues/11019

First step for porting ART deletion. Ports HasByte and the prefix walk in LookupInLeaf to pinned const handles. Delete uses HasByte, LookupInLeaf is used by the insert gate check and the insert/delete debug verification. LookupInLeaf now also throws on unknown node types instead of looping. Also removes the unused legacy Prefix::Iterator, superseded by ConstPrefixHandle::Iterator.
title: Buffer managed indexes 5a (deletion port) lookup in leaf
